title: Short term effect of Aldicarb on C.elegans
author: Priota Islam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baivice6
materials: Bleach synchronize the worms on a Friday

steps.title: Refeed arrested L1 worms
steps.instruction: Refeed arrested L1s on OP50 seeded plates, preparing 2 plates per strain.

steps.title: Prepare imaging plates
steps.instruction: Prepare 24 imaging plates for drug treatment and 24 imaging plates as non-treated controls.

substeps.instruction: Add 35µl of 2.5mM AK to the 24 drug-treatment plates
Seed all 48 imaging plates with 50µl of 1:10 OP50

steps.title: Transfer worms to plates
steps.instruction: Transfer 5 worms per strain onto the aldicarb treated plates and the control plates.

substeps.instruction: Incubate worms on the plates for 1.5 hours

steps.title: Image worms
steps.instruction: Image the worms for 15 minutes on Phenix Track.

substeps.instruction: Image 8 sets total: (2 treatment sets + 2 control sets with no treatment) x 2 growth temperatures
